rows.medi_said: أناا بدأت شغلي على تسعة ونص.

rows.medi_said: معروف is ground؟ معروف؟ No. خـ- خروف؟ ... مرفوف؟ What was it؟ What was ground؟

خضرة is feminine (sheet 'vegetables | 5udra | خضرة') so the adjective needs -a; he wavered to مختلفه then settled on masculine مختلف and Amal answered طيب.

rows.chat: e7na benfaddel enno inti ma tekserih
